name: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiary, PT Sarana Megahtama, provides carrier-neutral data center infrastructure services primarily in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Colocation Services and Others. The company offers dedicated and cabinet colocation services; cross connect services; Flexspace, which provides units of working space services; Smart Hands, an onsite technical support service; DCI Fabric, an interconnection service for enterprises; DCI-IX, an internet traffic exchange service; and DCI Connect, which offers internet access and direct connections to content providers. It serves the cloud service provider, e-commerce, enterprise, financial service, gaming, healthcare, and network service provider industries. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
